meta.description: The key to persuading others is coordinating your objectives.

units.rawText: On the top floor of the Reverse Tower of Babylon.
units.displayText: On the top floor of the Reverse Tower of Babylon.

spans.text: On the top floor of the Reverse Tower of Babylon.

units.rawText: —Reporting.
units.displayText: —Reporting.

spans.text: —Reporting.

units.rawText: Enter.
units.displayText: Enter.

spans.text: Enter.

units.rawText: Lord Eosphorus, I am here to report the progress on my recent tasks.
units.displayText: Lord Eosphorus, I am here to report the progress on my recent tasks.

spans.text: Lord Eosphorus, I am here to report the progress on my recent tasks.

units.rawText: What progress have you made?
units.displayText: What progress have you made?

spans.text: What progress have you made?

units.rawText: The Baptismal Font repair nodes are working at full capacity to repair the Sanctifiers that were injured in the Pierides Sector.
units.displayText: The Baptismal Font repair nodes are working at full capacity to repair the Sanctifiers that were injured in the Pierides Sector.

spans.text: The Baptismal Font repair nodes are working at full capacity to repair the Sanctifiers that were injured in the Pierides Sector.

units.rawText: However, the repair nodes can't be used on Sanctifiers who have suffered severe Entropization. Our healing operands will instead cause them more harm.
units.displayText: However, the repair nodes can't be used on Sanctifiers who have suffered severe Entropization. Our healing operands will instead cause them more harm.

spans.text: However, the repair nodes can't be used on Sanctifiers who have suffered severe Entropization. Our healing operands will instead cause them more harm.

units.rawText: I see. What tragic news.
units.displayText: I see. What tragic news.

spans.text: I see. What tragic news.

units.rawText: I apologize, Lord Eosphorus... I should be able to do better...
units.displayText: I apologize, Lord Eosphorus... I should be able to do better...

spans.text: I apologize, Lord Eosphorus... I should be able to do better...

units.rawText: Even so, the Reverse Tower of Babylon will not abandon those warriors who are still holding out.
units.displayText: Even so, the Reverse Tower of Babylon will not abandon those warriors who are still holding out.

spans.text: Even so, the Reverse Tower of Babylon will not abandon those warriors who are still holding out.

units.rawText: Keep looking for alternative solutions, Love.
units.displayText: Keep looking for alternative solutions, Love.

spans.text: Keep looking for alternative solutions, Love.

units.rawText: U-understood! Thank you very much for your understanding, Lord Eosphorus!
units.displayText: U-understood! Thank you very much for your understanding, Lord Eosphorus!

spans.text: U-understood! Thank you very much for your understanding, Lord Eosphorus!

units.rawText: Oh... there is one more thing I'd like to report.
units.displayText: Oh... there is one more thing I'd like to report.

spans.text: Oh... there is one more thing I'd like to report.

units.rawText: We've just received a message from the frontlines.
units.displayText: We've just received a message from the frontlines.

spans.text: We've just received a message from the frontlines.

units.rawText: From Hesperus?
units.displayText: From Hesperus?

spans.text: From Hesperus?

units.rawText: No, it wasn't from Lord Hesperus. Please be at ease, the situation on the border battlefront is still stable.
units.displayText: No, it wasn't from Lord Hesperus. Please be at ease, the situation on the border battlefront is still stable.

spans.text: No, it wasn't from Lord Hesperus. Please be at ease, the situation on the border battlefront is still stable.

units.rawText: But he did send an update, so please⁠—
units.displayText: But he did send an update, so please⁠—

spans.text: But he did send an update, so please⁠—

units.rawText: No need to go to that trouble. Just read it out to me.
units.displayText: No need to go to that trouble. Just read it out to me.

spans.text: No need to go to that trouble. Just read it out to me.

units.rawText: But I fear to give offense...
units.displayText: But I fear to give offense...

spans.text: But I fear to give offense...

units.rawText: It doesn't matter.
units.displayText: It doesn't matter.

spans.text: It doesn't matter.

units.rawText: ...Alright.
units.displayText: ...Alright.

spans.text: ...Alright.

units.rawText: Once Love is certain that her vocalization system is fully functional, she starts speaking while imitating Hesperus' tone.
units.displayText: Once Love is certain that her vocalization system is fully functional, she starts speaking while imitating Hesperus' tone.

spans.text: Once Love is certain that her vocalization system is fully functional, she starts speaking while imitating Hesperus' tone.

units.rawText: "Crime and Punishment's investigations have yielded some clues. They will hand you the evidence soon. You'd better take care of it quickly; undue delay may bring trouble, after all."
units.displayText: "Crime and Punishment's investigations have yielded some clues. They will hand you the evidence soon. You'd better take care of it quickly; undue delay may bring trouble, after all."

spans.text: "Crime and Punishment's investigations have yielded some clues. They will hand you the evidence soon. You'd better take care of it quickly; undue delay may bring trouble, after all."

units.rawText: "I hear there are signs of Entropy showing up in Magrasea. This is not a good sign, Eosphorus."
units.displayText: "I hear there are signs of Entropy showing up in Magrasea. This is not a good sign, Eosphorus."

spans.text: "I hear there are signs of Entropy showing up in Magrasea. This is not a good sign, Eosphorus."

units.rawText: "While I'm used to your soft-heartedness, don't give those Evil Spirits too long of a leash. You know who I'm talking about."
units.displayText: "While I'm used to your soft-heartedness, don't give those Evil Spirits too long of a leash. You know who I'm talking about."

spans.text: "While I'm used to your soft-heartedness, don't give those Evil Spirits too long of a leash. You know who I'm talking about."

units.rawText: ...That's all.
units.displayText: ...That's all.

spans.text: ...That's all.

units.rawText: I understand. Thank you, Love.
units.displayText: I understand. Thank you, Love.

spans.text: I understand. Thank you, Love.

units.rawText: Eosphorus waves a hand, indicating that Love can leave. However, Love stays put.
units.displayText: Eosphorus waves a hand, indicating that Love can leave. However, Love stays put.

spans.text: Eosphorus waves a hand, indicating that Love can leave. However, Love stays put.

units.rawText: Is something the matter?
units.displayText: Is something the matter?

spans.text: Is something the matter?

units.rawText: I-I beg your pardon once again, Lord Eosphorus.
units.displayText: I-I beg your pardon once again, Lord Eosphorus.

spans.text: I-I beg your pardon once again, Lord Eosphorus.

units.rawText: I heard that you personally brought Wisdom back from the Pierides Sector. If I may... How is she doing now?
units.displayText: I heard that you personally brought Wisdom back from the Pierides Sector. If I may... How is she doing now?

spans.text: I heard that you personally brought Wisdom back from the Pierides Sector. If I may... How is she doing now?

units.rawText: Are you that concerned about her?
units.displayText: Are you that concerned about her?

spans.text: Are you that concerned about her?

units.rawText: My deepest apologies, Lord Eosphorus! But it's true, I AM very worried about her... Please forgive me for overstepping...
units.displayText: My deepest apologies, Lord Eosphorus! But it's true, I AM very worried about her... Please forgive me for overstepping...

spans.text: My deepest apologies, Lord Eosphorus! But it's true, I AM very worried about her... Please forgive me for overstepping...

units.rawText: Be at ease. Such concern for your colleagues deserves praise.
units.displayText: Be at ease. Such concern for your colleagues deserves praise.

spans.text: Be at ease. Such concern for your colleagues deserves praise.

units.rawText: However, her condition is far from stable, so even I cannot make any definitive conclusions.
units.displayText: However, her condition is far from stable, so even I cannot make any definitive conclusions.

spans.text: However, her condition is far from stable, so even I cannot make any definitive conclusions.

units.rawText: Ah, Lord Eospho...
units.displayText: Ah, Lord Eospho...

spans.text: Ah, Lord Eospho...

units.rawText: Lord Eosphorus~ There's a situation in the Copley Sector... Huh?
units.displayText: Lord Eosphorus~ There's a situation in the Copley Sector... Huh?

spans.text: Lord Eosphorus~ There's a situation in the Copley Sector... Huh?

units.rawText: Before Love can finish, Eucharist pushes the door open and enters. Both girls fall silent abruptly.
units.displayText: Before Love can finish, Eucharist pushes the door open and enters. Both girls fall silent abruptly.

spans.text: Before Love can finish, Eucharist pushes the door open and enters. Both girls fall silent abruptly.

units.rawText: Eucharist looks at Love, then at Eosphorus. Her eyes glint with mischief as she suddenly breaks into a smile.
units.displayText: Eucharist looks at Love, then at Eosphorus. Her eyes glint with mischief as she suddenly breaks into a smile.

spans.text: Eucharist looks at Love, then at Eosphorus. Her eyes glint with mischief as she suddenly breaks into a smile.

units.rawText: Hm? Lord Eosphorus is usually the only one here at this time of day, so what are you doing here, Love?
units.displayText: Hm? Lord Eosphorus is usually the only one here at this time of day, so what are you doing here, Love?

spans.text: Hm? Lord Eosphorus is usually the only one here at this time of day, so what are you doing here, Love?

units.rawText: Let me guess, has Wisdom's condition gotten worse?
units.displayText: Let me guess, has Wisdom's condition gotten worse?

spans.text: Let me guess, has Wisdom's condition gotten worse?

units.rawText: Um, Lady Eucharist, suddenly barging in like this is not appropriate...
units.displayText: Um, Lady Eucharist, suddenly barging in like this is not appropriate...

spans.text: Um, Lady Eucharist, suddenly barging in like this is not appropriate...

units.rawText: Before expressing your concern for Wisdom, Eucharist, you ought to ask permission before entering.
units.displayText: Before expressing your concern for Wisdom, Eucharist, you ought to ask permission before entering.

spans.text: Before expressing your concern for Wisdom, Eucharist, you ought to ask permission before entering.

units.rawText: You were the one who gave Raven that rule. If you casually flout it, then how can you expect the Sanctifiers who consider the Greaters as role models to follow it?
units.displayText: You were the one who gave Raven that rule. If you casually flout it, then how can you expect the Sanctifiers who consider the Greaters as role models to follow it?

spans.text: You were the one who gave Raven that rule. If you casually flout it, then how can you expect the Sanctifiers who consider the Greaters as role models to follow it?

units.rawText: Sorry about that, but this is an emergency~ Can you forgive me, Lord Eosphorus?
units.displayText: Sorry about that, but this is an emergency~ Can you forgive me, Lord Eosphorus?

spans.text: Sorry about that, but this is an emergency~ Can you forgive me, Lord Eosphorus?

units.rawText: Go ahead. Tell me about this emergency which has caused you to forget proper decorum.
units.displayText: Go ahead. Tell me about this emergency which has caused you to forget proper decorum.

spans.text: Go ahead. Tell me about this emergency which has caused you to forget proper decorum.

units.rawText: We've received a distress signal from the Copley Sector.
units.displayText: We've received a distress signal from the Copley Sector.

spans.text: We've received a distress signal from the Copley Sector.

units.rawText: Oh?
units.displayText: Oh?

spans.text: Oh?

units.rawText: It just came in, and it scared the heck out of me!
units.displayText: It just came in, and it scared the heck out of me!

spans.text: It just came in, and it scared the heck out of me!

units.rawText: Um... Alerts like this should be sent to the Watchtower by the Sector early warning system so the duty personnel at the Watchtower can dispatch troops to handle it.
units.displayText: Um... Alerts like this should be sent to the Watchtower by the Sector early warning system so the duty personnel at the Watchtower can dispatch troops to handle it.

spans.text: Um... Alerts like this should be sent to the Watchtower by the Sector early warning system so the duty personnel at the Watchtower can dispatch troops to handle it.

units.rawText: Even if there IS a problem with the early warning system that requires the administrator to make the call for help, we have dedicated operators for handling that. Why are you relaying the message, Lady Eucharist?
units.displayText: Even if there IS a problem with the early warning system that requires the administrator to make the call for help, we have dedicated operators for handling that. Why are you relaying the message, Lady Eucharist?

spans.text: Even if there IS a problem with the early warning system that requires the administrator to make the call for help, we have dedicated operators for handling that. Why are you relaying the message, Lady Eucharist?

units.rawText: It can't be helped, I lost all my privileges so all I can do is work as an operator.
units.displayText: It can't be helped, I lost all my privileges so all I can do is work as an operator.

spans.text: It can't be helped, I lost all my privileges so all I can do is work as an operator.

units.rawText: (Sighs) I can't even eat my fill... Woe is me, even Love is busier than me...
units.displayText: (Sighs) I can't even eat my fill... Woe is me, even Love is busier than me...

spans.text: (Sighs) I can't even eat my fill... Woe is me, even Love is busier than me...

units.rawText: Did you come all the way here to put on a show of how miserable you were to your lower-ranked colleagues?
units.displayText: Did you come all the way here to put on a show of how miserable you were to your lower-ranked colleagues?

spans.text: Did you come all the way here to put on a show of how miserable you were to your lower-ranked colleagues?

units.rawText: Of course not, Lord Eosphorus~ I've got more important information than that⁠.
units.displayText: Of course not, Lord Eosphorus~ I've got more important information than that⁠.

spans.text: Of course not, Lord Eosphorus~ I've got more important information than that⁠.

units.rawText: The one who sent the distress signal is the "Professor" of the Oasis, using the Sector Administrator's permissions!
units.displayText: The one who sent the distress signal is the "Professor" of the Oasis, using the Sector Administrator's permissions!

spans.text: The one who sent the distress signal is the "Professor" of the Oasis, using the Sector Administrator's permissions!

units.rawText: Those Irregular Agents did what!?
units.displayText: Those Irregular Agents did what!?

spans.text: Those Irregular Agents did what!?

units.rawText: We're picking up large numbers of Entropic signals in the Copley Sector, and according to what the Professor said, the early warning system is totally busted.
units.displayText: We're picking up large numbers of Entropic signals in the Copley Sector, and according to what the Professor said, the early warning system is totally busted.

spans.text: We're picking up large numbers of Entropic signals in the Copley Sector, and according to what the Professor said, the early warning system is totally busted.

units.rawText: How could this be!? After the Pierides Sector, now even the Copley Sector has...
units.displayText: How could this be!? After the Pierides Sector, now even the Copley Sector has...

spans.text: How could this be!? After the Pierides Sector, now even the Copley Sector has...

units.rawText: While eliminating the Entropics is our main duty, the Professor seems terribly afraid that we won't send troops to help and offered the Sector Administrator permissions as collateral in exchange for our assistance.
units.displayText: While eliminating the Entropics is our main duty, the Professor seems terribly afraid that we won't send troops to help and offered the Sector Administrator permissions as collateral in exchange for our assistance.

spans.text: While eliminating the Entropics is our main duty, the Professor seems terribly afraid that we won't send troops to help and offered the Sector Administrator permissions as collateral in exchange for our assistance.

units.rawText: Of course, they asked for a small consideration, which is to allow them all to leave in peace. If you ask me, it's a simple enough condition to meet.
units.displayText: Of course, they asked for a small consideration, which is to allow them all to leave in peace. If you ask me, it's a simple enough condition to meet.

spans.text: Of course, they asked for a small consideration, which is to allow them all to leave in peace. If you ask me, it's a simple enough condition to meet.

units.rawText: What should we do, Lord Eosphorus?
units.displayText: What should we do, Lord Eosphorus?

spans.text: What should we do, Lord Eosphorus?

units.rawText: Sounds to me <cmdr> sent you here to make a case.
units.displayText: Sounds to me {교수} sent you here to make a case.

spans.text: Sounds to me
sent you here to make a case.

units.rawText: Aw, you know I like their Prof lots too.
units.displayText: Aw, you know I like their Prof lots too.

spans.text: Aw, you know I like their Prof lots too.

units.rawText: Hold on... I mean, excuse me, Lady Eucharist!
units.displayText: Hold on... I mean, excuse me, Lady Eucharist!

spans.text: Hold on... I mean, excuse me, Lady Eucharist!

units.rawText: Are you saying that you want us Sanctifiers to work with the Oasis?
units.displayText: Are you saying that you want us Sanctifiers to work with the Oasis?

spans.text: Are you saying that you want us Sanctifiers to work with the Oasis?

units.rawText: I've also heard that the Irregular Agents of the Oasis are different than other evil spirits, but isn't doing this too far out of line!?
units.displayText: I've also heard that the Irregular Agents of the Oasis are different than other evil spirits, but isn't doing this too far out of line!?

spans.text: I've also heard that the Irregular Agents of the Oasis are different than other evil spirits, but isn't doing this too far out of line!?

units.rawText: Well yeah, but there's been an abnormal spike of Entropic activity which calls for an unconventional solution. Two negatives make a positive and all that.
units.displayText: Well yeah, but there's been an abnormal spike of Entropic activity which calls for an unconventional solution. Two negatives make a positive and all that.

spans.text: Well yeah, but there's been an abnormal spike of Entropic activity which calls for an unconventional solution. Two negatives make a positive and all that.

units.rawText: You... This makes no sense.
units.displayText: You... This makes no sense.

spans.text: You... This makes no sense.

units.rawText: And why is that? If they hadn't stepped forward to inform us of this, we at the Reverse Tower would probably not have discovered what was going on in the Copley Sector.
units.displayText: And why is that? If they hadn't stepped forward to inform us of this, we at the Reverse Tower would probably not have discovered what was going on in the Copley Sector.

spans.text: And why is that? If they hadn't stepped forward to inform us of this, we at the Reverse Tower would probably not have discovered what was going on in the Copley Sector.

units.rawText: As the saying goes, do them a favor and they'll owe you one, right? We Sanctifiers ought to be good kids who repay kindness with kindness and practice fairness and justice.
units.displayText: As the saying goes, do them a favor and they'll owe you one, right? We Sanctifiers ought to be good kids who repay kindness with kindness and practice fairness and justice.

spans.text: As the saying goes, do them a favor and they'll owe you one, right? We Sanctifiers ought to be good kids who repay kindness with kindness and practice fairness and justice.

units.rawText: While it was our fault that the early warning systems malfunctioned... We can't use rule-breaking methods to solve a problem...
units.displayText: While it was our fault that the early warning systems malfunctioned... We can't use rule-breaking methods to solve a problem...

spans.text: While it was our fault that the early warning systems malfunctioned... We can't use rule-breaking methods to solve a problem...

units.rawText: Aw, how is this breaking the rules? It's just a teeny little bit of assistance.
units.displayText: Aw, how is this breaking the rules? It's just a teeny little bit of assistance.

spans.text: Aw, how is this breaking the rules? It's just a teeny little bit of assistance.

units.rawText: Anyway, after we're done working with them, we can still continue pursuing the Irregular Agents from the Oasis as normal, right?
units.displayText: Anyway, after we're done working with them, we can still continue pursuing the Irregular Agents from the Oasis as normal, right?

spans.text: Anyway, after we're done working with them, we can still continue pursuing the Irregular Agents from the Oasis as normal, right?

units.rawText: No, but... These Irregular Agents are right there...
units.displayText: No, but... These Irregular Agents are right there...

spans.text: No, but... These Irregular Agents are right there...

units.rawText: That's hardly breaking the rules though? We're tasked with "eliminating all Irregular Agents", but we don't necessarily have to do it right away, no?
units.displayText: That's hardly breaking the rules though? We're tasked with "eliminating all Irregular Agents", but we don't necessarily have to do it right away, no?

spans.text: That's hardly breaking the rules though? We're tasked with "eliminating all Irregular Agents", but we don't necessarily have to do it right away, no?

units.rawText: Also, think about it, there are sooooo many Sectors in Magrasea.
units.displayText: Also, think about it, there are sooooo many Sectors in Magrasea.

spans.text: Also, think about it, there are sooooo many Sectors in Magrasea.

units.rawText: If one early warning system went down, then the same thing might happen to a second one.
units.displayText: If one early warning system went down, then the same thing might happen to a second one.

spans.text: If one early warning system went down, then the same thing might happen to a second one.

units.rawText: If we wipe them out then and there, who will alert us to further loopholes in the future?
units.displayText: If we wipe them out then and there, who will alert us to further loopholes in the future?

spans.text: If we wipe them out then and there, who will alert us to further loopholes in the future?

units.rawText: ...But that's our job as Sanctifiers...! Lord Eosphorus...
units.displayText: ...But that's our job as Sanctifiers...! Lord Eosphorus...

spans.text: ...But that's our job as Sanctifiers...! Lord Eosphorus...

units.rawText: Love turns to Eosphorus pleadingly.
units.displayText: Love turns to Eosphorus pleadingly.

spans.text: Love turns to Eosphorus pleadingly.

units.rawText: Calm down, Love.
units.displayText: Calm down, Love.

spans.text: Calm down, Love.

units.rawText: M-my apologies.
units.displayText: M-my apologies.

spans.text: M-my apologies.

units.rawText: Eucharist, your words are suspect, but they are not without merit. To us, the safety of Magrasea will always be our top priority.
units.displayText: Eucharist, your words are suspect, but they are not without merit. To us, the safety of Magrasea will always be our top priority.

spans.text: Eucharist, your words are suspect, but they are not without merit. To us, the safety of Magrasea will always be our top priority.

units.rawText: Sweet! That's Lord Eosphorus for you, I knew you'd understand what I was thinking!
units.displayText: Sweet! That's Lord Eosphorus for you, I knew you'd understand what I was thinking!

spans.text: Sweet! That's Lord Eosphorus for you, I knew you'd understand what I was thinking!

units.rawText: So, uh... Who will you be sending to help them?
units.displayText: So, uh... Who will you be sending to help them?

spans.text: So, uh... Who will you be sending to help them?

units.rawText: My oh my, it seems Little Raven and Angelus just happen to be out at the moment! Looks like it will have to be—
units.displayText: My oh my, it seems Little Raven and Angelus just happen to be out at the moment! Looks like it will have to be—

spans.text: My oh my, it seems Little Raven and Angelus just happen to be out at the moment! Looks like it will have to be—

units.rawText: Love will go.
units.displayText: Love will go.

spans.text: Love will go.

units.rawText: <size=40>Ehhhhhh!?</size>
units.displayText: Ehhhhhh!?

spans.text: Ehhhhhh!?

units.rawText: Lord Eosphorus, I...
units.displayText: Lord Eosphorus, I...

spans.text: Lord Eosphorus, I...

units.rawText: Eucharist, is the Watchtower looking into the reports of Entropics in the Copley Sector?
units.displayText: Eucharist, is the Watchtower looking into the reports of Entropics in the Copley Sector?

spans.text: Eucharist, is the Watchtower looking into the reports of Entropics in the Copley Sector?

units.rawText: Yeah, they're looking into it, but why not me...
units.displayText: Yeah, they're looking into it, but why not me...

spans.text: Yeah, they're looking into it, but why not me...

units.rawText: In that case, we have a source of information, as well as knowledge of the grades and numbers of the Entropics we shall face.
units.displayText: In that case, we have a source of information, as well as knowledge of the grades and numbers of the Entropics we shall face.

spans.text: In that case, we have a source of information, as well as knowledge of the grades and numbers of the Entropics we shall face.

units.rawText: Bring ample troops, then deal with them the way you've been taught.
units.displayText: Bring ample troops, then deal with them the way you've been taught.

spans.text: Bring ample troops, then deal with them the way you've been taught.

units.rawText: But—I don't mean to second-guess your decision—but why am I the one...
units.displayText: But—I don't mean to second-guess your decision—but why am I the one...

spans.text: But—I don't mean to second-guess your decision—but why am I the one...

units.rawText: There are limits to how far I can see, and there will always be more emergencies than there are contingency plans to address them.
units.displayText: There are limits to how far I can see, and there will always be more emergencies than there are contingency plans to address them.

spans.text: There are limits to how far I can see, and there will always be more emergencies than there are contingency plans to address them.

units.rawText: Eosphorus looks evenly at Love, who is cowering before him.
units.displayText: Eosphorus looks evenly at Love, who is cowering before him.

spans.text: Eosphorus looks evenly at Love, who is cowering before him.

units.rawText: You will have to face the darkness alone someday, just like Wisdom, because that is a Sanctifier's destiny.
units.displayText: You will have to face the darkness alone someday, just like Wisdom, because that is a Sanctifier's destiny.

spans.text: You will have to face the darkness alone someday, just like Wisdom, because that is a Sanctifier's destiny.

units.rawText: Many evils still lurk within Magrasea.
units.displayText: Many evils still lurk within Magrasea.

spans.text: Many evils still lurk within Magrasea.

units.rawText: We cannot rely solely on the Greaters. You must grow as well.
units.displayText: We cannot rely solely on the Greaters. You must grow as well.

spans.text: We cannot rely solely on the Greaters. You must grow as well.

units.rawText: You have a point.
units.displayText: You have a point.

spans.text: You have a point.

units.rawText: In addition, perhaps this encounter with them will give you a more direct understanding of the things I have taught you.
units.displayText: In addition, perhaps this encounter with them will give you a more direct understanding of the things I have taught you.

spans.text: In addition, perhaps this encounter with them will give you a more direct understanding of the things I have taught you.

units.rawText: In both matters of battle and ideals.
units.displayText: In both matters of battle and ideals.

spans.text: In both matters of battle and ideals.

units.rawText: Yes... I understand, Lord Eosphorus!
units.displayText: Yes... I understand, Lord Eosphorus!

spans.text: Yes... I understand, Lord Eosphorus!

units.rawText: Thank you very much for your trust! I will not disappoint you!
units.displayText: Thank you very much for your trust! I will not disappoint you!

spans.text: Thank you very much for your trust! I will not disappoint you!

units.rawText: After accepting her mission, Love departs swiftly.
units.displayText: After accepting her mission, Love departs swiftly.

spans.text: After accepting her mission, Love departs swiftly.

units.rawText: Why do I get the feeling that I've been cast aside...? Meh.
units.displayText: Why do I get the feeling that I've been cast aside...? Meh.

spans.text: Why do I get the feeling that I've been cast aside...? Meh.

units.rawText: I do not recall you griping like this when you were idling during work. Why start now?
units.displayText: I do not recall you griping like this when you were idling during work. Why start now?

spans.text: I do not recall you griping like this when you were idling during work. Why start now?

units.rawText: But slacking off and being bored because you've been fired are totally different things! Why didn't you send me, Lord Eosphorus?
units.displayText: But slacking off and being bored because you've been fired are totally different things! Why didn't you send me, Lord Eosphorus?

spans.text: But slacking off and being bored because you've been fired are totally different things! Why didn't you send me, Lord Eosphorus?

units.rawText: I thought I could finally trick you into— Uh, I mean, I thought I could talk you into giving my trident back...
units.displayText: I thought I could finally trick you into— Uh, I mean, I thought I could talk you into giving my trident back...

spans.text: I thought I could finally trick you into— Uh, I mean, I thought I could talk you into giving my trident back...

units.rawText: You have a more important task to perform.
units.displayText: You have a more important task to perform.

spans.text: You have a more important task to perform.

units.rawText: ...What? A-a more important task!?
units.displayText: ...What? A-a more important task!?

spans.text: ...What? A-a more important task!?

units.rawText: Once Crime and Punishment have finished their investigations, we will be holding a trial for you.
units.displayText: Once Crime and Punishment have finished their investigations, we will be holding a trial for you.

spans.text: Once Crime and Punishment have finished their investigations, we will be holding a trial for you.

units.rawText: Urgh—!?
units.displayText: Urgh—!?

spans.text: Urgh—!?

units.rawText: ...But those two are huge pains in the butt, even if I'm innocent, it'll be really annoying once they've gotten their hooks into me...
units.displayText: ...But those two are huge pains in the butt, even if I'm innocent, it'll be really annoying once they've gotten their hooks into me...

spans.text: ...But those two are huge pains in the butt, even if I'm innocent, it'll be really annoying once they've gotten their hooks into me...

units.rawText: The trial will be absolutely just. Wait for the verdict, Eucharist.
units.displayText: The trial will be absolutely just. Wait for the verdict, Eucharist.

spans.text: The trial will be absolutely just. Wait for the verdict, Eucharist.

units.rawText: Go back to taking calls until the curtain falls on all this chaos.
units.displayText: Go back to taking calls until the curtain falls on all this chaos.

spans.text: Go back to taking calls until the curtain falls on all this chaos.

units.rawText: Eh, why do I STILL have to take calls!? I thought—
units.displayText: Eh, why do I STILL have to take calls!? I thought—

spans.text: Eh, why do I STILL have to take calls!? I thought—

units.rawText: You asked for this job, and now you must complete it properly.
